q: How fast does waste heat recovery on a ceramic roller kiln pay back?
title: Roller kiln waste heat recovery payback
short: In under a year at 2010 prices. BEE's Morbi report fits a recuperator to a vitrified tile roller kiln's preheating zone exhaust, warming burner air to about 175 C and saving 295 scm of gas a day, 3.1% of the kiln's use. Cost Rs 8.46 lakh, saving Rs 10.44 lakh a year, about 143 t CO2.
audience: Vitrified and floor tile makers in Morbi whose roller kiln smoke air still goes up the stack hot

p: A roller kiln has two hot exhausts. Most Morbi units already send final cooling zone air, at 250 to 300 C, to their dryers. This project takes the other one: flue gas from the preheating zone, which leaves at about 249 C. A shell and tube recuperator of 32 m2 cools it to about 125 C and passes the heat, about 108,000 kcal an hour, to the combustion air.

ul: 5,929 m2 of vitrified tile a day (15,980 tiles), firing at about 1,223 C.
9,540 scm of gas a day, about 1.61 scm per m2.
Preheating zone flue gas carried about 5% of the heat input.
236 working days a year in the report's sums.
Recuperator Rs 6.90 lakh, fitting Rs 0.35 lakh, taxes Rs 0.35 lakh, interest Rs 0.18 lakh, contingency Rs 0.69 lakh: Rs 8.46 lakh.
Saving: 295 scm x 236 days = 69,620 scm at Rs 15 = Rs 10.44 lakh. The cover table labels this kWh; it is scm.
Payback 0.8 years. At 330 firing days the saving rises to about 97,000 scm.
Twelve days of kiln downtime to fit the ducting.
Log flue temperature after the recuperator weekly; a rise means fouling.
Check burner air pressure after fitting, since hot air takes more volume and burners may need retuning.
Track gas per m2 fired, not monthly gas, which moves with output.

example.title: One kiln, one year
lines: Gas saved: 295 scm x 236 days = 69,620 scm
Per m2: 1.61 scm (3.30 kg CO2) falls to 1.56 scm (3.20 kg)
The report's own figure is 142 t
example.note: Natural gas at our factor of 2.05 kg CO2 a scm, an estimate.

senseible: Senseible reads gas bills into monthly records with CO2 at 2.05 kg a scm, so gas per m2 before and after the recuperator can be shown to a lender or an EU buyer. The green loan check shows what a lender asks for.
